svg.title: Python, C++, and iOS experience
svg.desc: PYTHON: Python, FastAPI, Django, PyTorch, TensorFlow. Neural network development & training; Data: NumPy / pandas / SciPy / scikit-learn; Visualization & imaging: Matplotlib / Seaborn / OpenCV / Pillow; Web: Flask / SQLAlchemy / requests / aiohttp / httpx / asyncio; Tools: pytest / Jupyter Notebook / pip. C++: C++, Qt, Boost, CMake, OpenGL. Libraries & parallelism: STL / nlohmann/json / OpenSSL / OpenMP; Testing: GoogleTest; Tools: Make / GCC / Clang / GDB / LLDB. iOS: Swift, Objective-C, UIKit, SwiftUI. Core APIs & data: Foundation / Combine / Core Data; Animation, media & maps: Core Animation / AVFoundation / MapKit; Tools: Xcode / Swift Package Manager / CocoaPods.
